messages:
alyssa: p99 SLO alert for hosted-infer-usw2 — SLO burned 14% in the last 5m, 5xxs and timeouts spiking. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/apps/hosted-infer/usw2/slo
ben: seeing it, pulling traces now. any customer-facing reports?
support-jamie: yes — AcmeCorp reported repeated timeouts from their integration around 18:40 UTC, session ids: sess-7f2a, sess-7f2b. They say retries cause duplicate tokens.
oncall-bot: ALERT: hosted-infer-usw2 p99 latency SLO burn >10% (5m) — alert id A-75932 — linked runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-timeouts
maya: quick logs query I ran: `logs.query("service:ingress AND region:usw2 AND status:5xx", span: 10m)` shows a tail of `503 handshake timeout` originating from `edge-proxy-3`.
ben: digging into edge-proxy-3: increased TLS handshake timeouts to backend ips 10.12.45.* after 18:38. RTT to kvcache hosts jumps to 300-600ms.
alyssa: interesting — prefetch backlog had a small surge last night; could be KV stall + batching causing request head-of-line. Can anyone check prefetch queue depth?
maya: prefetch queue depth graph: https://console.redwood.ai/d/metrics/prefetch-queue?panel=depth&region=usw2 shows spike from 40->820 around 18:36.
ben: traced a failed request: trace id `6a7b9c` — span shows `edge-proxy -> ingress` ok, then `ingress -> kvcache` waited 520ms then connection reset. Missing child spans for some retry attempts (tracing gaps).
alyssa: tracing gap — likely due to a short-lived sidecar restart or sampling change. Any recent deploys?
ben: no deploys in us-west-2 in the timeframe (checked deploy-bot). kernel metrics show small OOM kill event on kvcache-host-7 at 18:35, container restarted.
support-jamie: customer impact: AcmeCorp saw ~8 failed requests and then retried which caused duplicate invoices. Ops asked for a repro so they can roll back client retries.
maya: repro steps I can give them:
```
1) POST /v1/generate with header `x-client-retries: 3`
2) use model `redwood/open-8b-quant` pinned to us-west-2
3) simulate network latency to kvcache (tc qdisc netem delay 400ms)
```
That reproduces p99 timeouts locally for us.
alyssa: good. Immediate mitigations: 1) add ingress fallback to smaller model variant for requests with `x-client-escalation` header, 2) mark kvcache-host-7 as draining in the router so traffic moves off it, 3) open a mitigation PR to reduce prefetch concurrency for us-west-2.
ben: I manually marked kvcache-host-7 draining (done). Router health now shifts — error rate down but still elevated.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1834 (hosted-infer-usw2-timeout-wave). Pager duty: SRE-oncall.
maya: logs for the window: `errors.count{service:ingress,region:usw2}@18:30-18:50` -> 5xxs mostly `handshake timeout` and `connection reset`. Query attached: https://logs.redwood.ai/q/7fd2b
ben: root cause hypothesis: transient kvcache host oom -> restart -> prefetch backlog spike -> edge-proxy handshake timeouts to backend -> tracing gaps (span sampling + restart) -> client retries amplify errors.
alyssa: action items:
- ben: follow up with infra to check why kvcache OOMed (vm metrics, memory cgroup) — owner: ben — ETA 1h
- maya: add reproducible test in chaos lab to simulate kvcache restart + measure SLO impact — owner: maya — ETA 24h
- support-jamie: notify AcmeCorp with repro steps and advise exponential backoff on client side; escalate if billing duplicates seen — owner: support-jamie — ETA 30m
support-jamie: pinged AcmeCorp and sent repro steps + mitigation to disable aggressive client retries. they acked and will hold charges while we investigate :thumbsup:
ben: infra found a mem leak in kvcache version 2.3.1 — rolling a hotfix to 2.3.2 in us-west-2 canary now. deployment code:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kvcache --image=redwood/kvcache:2.3.2-canary
```
alyssa: after canary stabilizes we schedule broader rollback/hotfix. Also add an alert to detect prefetch queue growth earlier: threshold 200 for 1m.
maya: I will add the alert and a dashboard panel for tracing coverage so we can detect span gaps sooner.
ben: can confirm canary reduced 5xx rate by 70% on the host group after 6m.
alyssa: closing thread for now; leave INC-2026-1834 open until postmortem. Will collect logs/traces and create a short RCA doc. :white_check_mark:
